title: Customer cancellation: quote, cancel, money step
caption: bookings.quoteCancellation and bookings.cancel (ota/docs/flows/change-and-cancel.md §2-§3, src/bookings/cancellation.service.ts, cancellation-mode.ts). Modes: release (nothing ticketed), void (every ticket issued today in storefront_settings.time_zone), request_only (staff), not_allowed.

steps.label: Flight Order Management GET (refund fare rules)
POST /v1/bookings/{id}/cancellation {expectedRefund} + If-Match + Idempotency-Key
steps.note: Different or missing expectedRefund: 409 REFUND_AMOUNT_CHANGED. Ticketing in progress: 409 BOOKING_NOT_MODIFIABLE (ticketing_in_progress).

steps.label: Flight Order Management DELETE (release / void only)
booking cancelled (cancelled_at, cancelled_by customer), segments/tickets, booking.cancelled event, refunds row, outbox booking.cancelled
refund.submit on ota-payments after the commit (captured payment); safety-net capture/void job (10 min); document.render cancelled itinerary
200 Cancellation (booking cancelled; refund pending until Stripe answers) or 202 Cancellation.status = pending (request_only: the staff complete it)

after the commit, an authorised payment: capture the kept amount (pi:capture:<pay_id>:cancellation:<amount>), Stripe releases the rest; nothing kept: void (pi:cancel:<pay_id>); a failure → payment.capture_retry / payment.void 10 min later
refund.submit: Stripe refund of a captured payment (idempotency key refund:<rfd_id>)
webhook charge.refunded → ota-stripe-events → refund succeeded, payment partially_refunded / refunded
